instructions:
DynamoDB MCP Proxy - Enables AI assistant to perform DynamoDB operations through natural language.

**Environment Variables Required:**
- AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: IAM access key for dynamodb-mcp-proxy user
- AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: IAM secret key for dynamodb-mcp-proxy user
- DYNAMODB_API_ENDPOINT: API Gateway invoke URL (e.g., https://xxxx.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod)

**Example Kiro IDE Setup:**
1. Set environment variables in your shell or Kiro IDE config
2. Update DYNAMODB_API_ENDPOINT with your actual API Gateway URL (from apply.sh output)
3. Ensure AWS credentials have permission for dynamodb-mcp-proxy role
4. Start Kiro IDE - it will automatically connect to the proxy
